name: Yaftino
author: Mohammad Hasan Manavi

sections.description:
Help visitors find what they mean, even when they type it differently.

Someone searches for اداپتور, but your product is called آداپتور. Another visitor types نرم افزار while your article uses نرم‌افزار. Yaftino helps these searches connect with your content, using the search form your site already has.

Use it for a blog, a WooCommerce shop, or a site with both. Yaftino improves matching and gives relevant titles priority, while keeping your theme’s search layout and the content itself unchanged. Persian and English search are supported; Arabic matching can be enabled when you need it.

Different spellings, useful results

  • Match Persian and Arabic forms of ی/ي and ک/ك, and Persian, Arabic and English digits.
  • In ordinary Persian search, آ and ا match automatically.
  • Handle supported space and half-space variants without adding a synonym for every spelling.
  • Keep quantities distinct: ۵۰وات matches 50 W, not 500 W; 5 cm is different from 5 mm.

Make search fit your content

  • Add your own synonyms for alternate names, brands or equivalent phrases: up to 500 groups, with 2–10 phrases each.
  • Choose language-specific groups or share a group across supported languages.
  • Give title matches priority while respecting an explicitly selected sort order.
  • Optionally improve search in the dashboard Posts and Products lists, preserving product ID and SKU lookup.
  • Optionally let shoppers find products with a complete SKU, including a variation SKU that leads to its parent product.

Help after a search finds nothing

Persian keyboard correction can try the same keys in the Persian layout after an empty search. You can also turn on close matches for some typing mistakes, last-word completion, model-code beginnings, or Persian singular/plural matching. Each option has its own safeguards; numbers, units and other search filters stay protected. These features do not promise a match for every typo.

With the matching options enabled, lamp pa can find lamp park, and 7823 can find a title containing model 7823B. Your own synonyms can connect names such as LED and ال‌ای‌دی.

See what visitors are looking for

Optional local statistics show search phrases, how often they were searched, and searches with or without results. Results-page searches and supported live-search requests have separate reports. Filter the reports and delete selected records or clear them all whenever you need to. You can also download the filtered report as a CSV file for a spreadsheet, including results beyond the current page. For very large reports, narrow the dates or phrase before downloading.

Use the built-in Test search page to try phrases and see how Yaftino matched them before testing your theme’s form.

Your site, your search form

Yaftino is free and runs search locally, without an external search account or subscription. It follows the content types, language, permissions and filters of supported searches. It does not add a new search bar or replace your theme’s result design.

Start with the features you need. Arabic matching, dashboard matching, statistics, Persian plurals, close matches and word/model-prefix completion are off on a new installation.

Privacy

Local tables hold normalized text, spellings and optional source-linked title words/model codes. Title words serve close matches and completion. Tables grow with content. Matching and statistics use no external services or tracking identifiers.

Optional statistics store search phrases, dates, language, content types, request source and aggregate counts, without IP addresses, user IDs or cookies. Search phrases can contain personal information. Retention is up to 90 days while scheduled cleanup runs, with a periodically enforced target of 50,000 daily aggregate rows. Cleanup needs working WordPress cron or manual continuation. Admins can delete selected/all records. Disclose collection in your privacy policy before enabling it.

Optional feedback by email

Feedback never interrupts activation, deactivation or deletion. Admins must check consent (initially unchecked) and click Send feedback by email.

Feedback goes to yaftino.support@gmail.com. It includes the selected reason, message, Yaftino version and optional reply address entered by the administrator. No statistics, content, customer data, IP address or site URL is attached automatically.

Mail headers may include the sender address; providers may retain logs. Yaftino does not store messages or send them to WordPress.org. Only a one-minute rate-limit timestamp is stored until uninstall. The developer’s Gmail mailbox is subject to Google Privacy Policy and Google Terms.

Mail acceptance does not guarantee delivery. Do not send secrets, license keys or customer information. Uninstall never sends feedback.

Third-party resources

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Yaftino on single-site WordPress.
  2. Open Yaftino > Settings and choose your content language and features.
  3. Open Prepare search, click the main button and keep the page open until ready. You can pause and resume. Then try your existing search form.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce or a particular theme?

No. WooCommerce is optional. Yaftino improves supported WordPress searches in titles, excerpts and content. In a shop, you can optionally enable complete SKU lookup. Supported live search uses WordPress queries; custom engines and REST/Store API searches are outside this integration.

Does every space or plural become equivalent?

No. Real half-spaces in prepared public content or in the search phrase guide supported spacing matches; separate words are not joined by guessing. Optional Persian plurals link final ها/های using real half-space evidence, including short words such as گل. Other suffixes and irregular plurals are not included.

How do I add synonyms?

Put 2–10 equivalent phrases in one group, one per line, and choose its language. You can create up to 500 groups. Edit an existing group to add another spelling. Import can add groups or replace all of them; Add skips duplicates and reports overlaps for you to resolve.

How does Arabic matching work?

Enable Arabic matching and prepare search. Common vowel marks are ignored, while hamza, madda, distinct letters and Quranic signs remain meaningful. In this mode آ and ا remain different, including in Persian text. Original content stays unchanged; this is not a tool for equating every Quranic spelling style.

Does it work on a multilingual site?

Tested with WPML 5.0.2 and Polylang 3.9.1 for supported Persian, English and optional Arabic searches. Search language comes from the translation setup, not the dashboard language. All-language queries, translation fallbacks, TranslatePress and commercial WooCommerce translation add-ons keep native behavior. Urdu and Pashto profiles are not included.

What changes in dashboard search?

Enable dashboard matching to use Yaftino in the Posts and Products lists. Title matches come first unless you select another order. Enabled Persian keyboard correction can retry after zero results. ID, SKU, variation SKU, permissions and filters remain. Close matches and word/model-prefix completion stay off in these lists; dashboard searches are not recorded in statistics.

When should I prepare search again?

Ordinary edits and deletions update automatically. After changing language, Arabic or dashboard matching, or enabling plurals, close matches or word/model prefixes, follow the Prepare search status. Normal search stays available until ready. Synonym edits need no preparation. Rebuild after imports that bypass WordPress save hooks.

What is outside the current scope?

Custom fields, category names, partial SKU matching and unit conversion are not included. Search enhancement is for single-site WordPress. Multisite activation leaves search unchanged. Detected replacement engines are explained in Settings; unsupported searches keep native matching. Deactivation keeps data; single-site deletion removes Yaftino data, not your content.
sections.changelog:
0.8.7

  • Optional full WooCommerce SKU lookup on the site, including variation SKUs.
  • Add-only synonym import with duplicate and overlap reporting.
  • Refine the synonym import form spacing.
  • Improve dashboard title ranking and Persian keyboard correction while preserving sorting and identifiers.
  • Download filtered search statistics as a CSV file across report pages.
  • Refresh bundled translations and the directory introduction.

See changelog.txt for older changes.
